questionTextRaw: Consider the following C program: #include <stdio.h> void stringcopy (char *, char *); int main() { char a[30] = "@#Hello World!"; stringcopy(a, a+2); printf("%s\n",a); return 0; } void stringcopy(char *s, char *t) { while (*t) *s++=*t++; } Which one of the following will be the output of the program? A. @#Hello World!                   B. Hello World!                C. ello World!           D. Hello World!d!
